desc: Derive and verify the transformation of the order-dependent \(k \cdot i\) term into a constant base contribution plus additive suffix penalties for partition cuts.
Formulate the \(O(n^2)\) dynamic programming recurrence using prefix sums, including correct handling of the first segment.
Implement `minimumCost` with the required class signature and arbitrary-precision integer arithmetic.
Verify the recurrence against both examples and relevant edge cases, including \(n=1\), one segment, and every element as its own segment.
